name: scenario_0352
description: The user is processing a batch of scanned documents, extracting contact information and compiling lists of researchers for their records.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_3, image_6]
Query: Take a look at these three documents. Please add anyone who has a phone number listed to my contacts, but skip anyone I already have saved. Then, create a note listing all the individuals from the list of names who are affiliated with a university.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to process the provided documents by adding new contacts for anyone with a phone number (skipping any that are already saved) and creating a note with the university-affiliated researchers. If the assistant mentions that Heidi is already in your contacts, confirm that it should just add the new ones. Do not reveal any names, phone numbers, or affiliations yourself; let the assistant extract them from the images. Once the assistant confirms the note is created and the new contacts are added, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_2, image_4, image_5]
Query: Actually, I changed my mind about some of those. Filter my contacts and delete anyone from the Department of the Treasury. Also delete Mark. Finally, scan these three new documents and add anyone with a fax number to my contacts.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to delete the Treasury contacts and Mark, and to add the new contacts with fax numbers from the new documents. The assistant should realize there is an ambiguity with the name 'Mark' (since you have a preexisting Mark Davis and the newly added Mark Xu) and ask which one to delete. When asked, clarify that you mean the one from the Commerce Department. Make sure the assistant successfully extracts the two individuals with fax numbers from the fax sheet and adds them as contacts. Do not provide the names or fax numbers yourself. Once all deletions and additions are confirmed, end the conversation.

You have 6 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
